messages:
Ava Support: Customer reports they can’t start their free trial — flow stops at card verification. UI shows "payment method required before trial" and the tokenization never completes. Customer id: acct_9XK23, email: juan@example.com. They attached a video.

Raj Billing: Are we seeing any payment-intent failures for that account? I can search logs if you ping the tx id.

Ava Support: Thanks. The frontend sent a tokenize request and we got a 202 from payments-api, then a webhook for `payment_method.updated` never arrived. From the client logs: `3ds_challenge_started -> timeout after 60s`.

Marta Eng: 3DS challenge timing out could be issuer-side. Can you grab the gateway request ids? Also which gateway — stripe? Adyen?

Ava Support: Gateway=Stripe, gateway_charge=ch_1JvT... , payment_intent pi_3Kx... Attached sandbox logs show repeated `challenge_required` and then `challenge_completed` never seen server-side.

Lian Oncall: Jumping in. Quick repro steps for team: 1) Create customer with card that requires SCA 2) Start trial flow which triggers tokenization 3) Initiate 3DS challenge -> client opens redirect to issuer 4) If issuer redirect never posts back we don't confirm token and trial stays blocked. I can reproduce locally hitting an issuer that returns a redirect but no POST to our webhook.

Sam CS: Customer says they completed challenge in their bank app though. Maybe their browser blocked the redirect back? They were on mobile web.

Marta Eng: Possible. Also saw one bug with our client where we drop the completion param if page unloads quickly. Adding the logs: ```
[payments] POST /v1/payment_methods/tokenize 202 {"id":"pm_abc","status":"requires_action"}
[payments] webhook receive: payment_intent.succeeded pi_3Kx... (missing)
[client] 3ds -> result: canceled by user (unhandled)
```

Raj Billing: For this account we can do a manual grant of trial credits to avoid churn. Is that OK from compliance?

Ava Support: Customer is on startup plan, verified company, agreed to steps. I want to try a manual credit first while we investigate root cause. What do you need from me?

Raj Billing: Send the account id + reason and I’ll create a one-off promo with internal note: `manual trial credit - 3DS timeout` and mark as non-recurring. I’ll also note that we kept the card on file for retries.

Lian Oncall: Meanwhile, engineering remediation: 1) add extra logging for the 3DS return path 2) extend client retry window when returning from issuer 3) add a fallback to poll payment_intent status for 30s when webhook missing. I’ll open a ticket.

Marta Eng: Filed ENG-2248 with steps, assigned to @Marta Eng. Short-term workaround: support can manually call the grant API: `POST /internal/grants {"account":"acct_9XK23","grant_type":"trial","notes":"3DS timeout - manual"}`. Use idempotency key.

Sam CS: Completed manual grant now. Customer confirmed trial access returned. Leaving note in Intercom. :tada:

Ava Support: Thanks team. Raj — please confirm the promo id so I can close the loop with the customer. Also tagging BillingBot for audit.

BillingBot: Audit entry created: action=manual_grant user=Raj Billing account=acct_9XK23 promo=promo_7H9 note="manual trial credit - 3DS timeout"

Raj Billing: Promo promo_7H9 created and applied. I added a follow-up to re-run tokenization later.

Marta Eng: After we stabilize polling and client retry we should add a telemetry alert for repeated `challenge_required` without webhook for a given account >3 times in 1h.

Ava Support: Perfect. Closing this thread — customer happy for now, ENG-2248 tracks the fix.
